subject: Medford Standard Compensation Ordinance
overview: The committee met to consider an amendment establishing a standard compensation floor for contracted city services. The item was kept in committee to allow the Procurement Department and administration to review the proposal's legal and operational feasibility.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Kept in committee a proposed ordinance establishing a wage and benefit floor for contracted janitorial and security services to prevent the undercutting of union labor. City administration staff expressed concerns regarding the availability of wage data and the potential impact on existing contracts.
